releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.13
releases.body:
## Fixed

- **The title screen's models turned white after leaving stage select** (#6). The title's new lighting cube map has
  the same address, format and size as the stage-select one, so it shared that GPU image and was never read from
  game memory again: the title was lit with stage-select's lighting. A texture that takes over a shared image now
  reads it again. Checked on Windows (RTX) and Adreno 740.
  `NX_SHARE_REUPLOAD=0` in `config.txt` restores the old behaviour, for comparison.
- **Grass, bushes and leaves drawn as solid light-green blocks** (#7, e.g. at the start of Chapter 4). Foliage is
  drawn in two passes: a depth pass that discards the cards' transparent texels, then a colour pass that only draws
  where the depth is EQUAL. That EQUAL was run as LESS_OR_EQUAL (a workaround for a precision problem on Metal),
  so the colour pass also drew every transparent texel. EQUAL now stays EQUAL, as on the console, everywhere but
  Apple. Checked on Windows (RTX) and Adreno 740.
  `NX_EQUAL_AS_LEQUAL=1` restores the old behaviour. If you see new black edges or missing surfaces, please open an
  issue with a bug report.

## Coming from v0.3.12

- Android: install the new APK and tap **SET UP** again so the phone rebuilds the game with the new runtime.
- Windows / Linux / Steam Deck: unpack over your folder and choose **Rebuild** in the launcher.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.12
releases.body:
## New

- **Controller rumble on Android.** The game's vibration now reaches the controller you play with, as it already
  did on Windows and Linux. On Android 12 or later, a controller with two motors gets the left and right strengths
  separately; older versions use a single motor. The phone itself never vibrates. `NX_RUMBLE=0` in `config.txt`
  turns it off.
  - Checked that it builds and runs on a Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 phone; it has not been felt on a real controller yet.
    If your controller does not rumble, please open an issue with `nx.log` (look for the `rumble:` line).
- **The game follows your system language.** New installs default to "Same as the system" (desktop launcher) /
  "System language" (Android): the game's text matches the language Windows, Linux or the phone is set to, with
  regional variants (Traditional Chinese for Taiwan and Hong Kong, Latin American Spanish, UK English). A language
  the game has no text in falls back to English (US). If you already picked a language, it stays as it is.
- **Screenshots.** F12 (on Linux / Steam Deck also a controller's Share/Capture button) saves the game picture
  as a PNG in `screenshots/` under the game's data folder, at the render size and without the frame-rate overlay.
- **Make a bug report** (desktop launcher). One click writes `private/reports/b3-report-<date>.zip` with a short
  system summary, the recent game, setup and crash logs and your `b3.conf`, then shows it in the file manager.
  It holds no game files, so you can attach it to an issue as it is.
- **Show frame rate** is now a switch in the desktop launcher's video settings (`fps_overlay=1`), instead of an
  environment variable only.

## Also

- README: the status no longer says the Prologue → Chapter 1 transition hangs (fixed in v0.3.9).

## Coming from v0.3.11

- Android: install the new APK and tap **SET UP** again so the phone rebuilds the game with the new runtime.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.11
releases.body:
## Android: a workaround for the Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 (Adreno 750) crash at startup

- **On phones with an Adreno 750 GPU, the game could close while the title screen loaded** (issue #5). The v0.3.10
  crash report showed the crash is inside Qualcomm's own shader compiler (`libllvm-qgl.so`), in its 512.762 driver
  series. Other projects see the same driver crash on one GPU instruction, the subgroup shuffle, which about a
  quarter of this game's shaders use.
  - On an Adreno 750, or any Qualcomm GPU with a 512.762 driver, those shaders now use an equivalent instruction
    (shuffle-xor) that the driver compiles. The result is the same; other GPUs are not affected.
  - Checked with the rewrite forced on: Windows and a Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 (Adreno 740) phone show the same picture as
    without it. It has not yet been run on an Adreno 750: if you have one, please report whether the game now starts.
  - `NX_SHUFFLE_XOR=0` in `config.txt` turns it off, `=1` forces it on.

Windows and Linux builds are unchanged in behaviour.

## Coming from v0.3.10

- Android: install the new APK and tap **SET UP** again so the phone rebuilds the game with the new runtime.
- Windows / Linux / Steam Deck: no need to update.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.10
releases.body:
## Android: clearer crash reports

- When the game crashes on Android, `nx.log` now names the thread that crashed and where the crash happened (the
  library and offset, such as the game's own library or the GPU driver), with a short backtrace. Before, a crash
  outside the game's own threads left only a fault address, which could not show whether the cause was ours or the
  phone's (issue #5).
- Nothing else changes. If your game crashed on Android, please update and attach the new `nx.log` to your issue.

Windows and Linux builds are unchanged in behaviour.

## Coming from v0.3.9

- Android: install the new APK and tap **SET UP** again so the phone rebuilds the game with the new runtime.
- Windows / Linux / Steam Deck: no need to update.

releases.name: Bayonetta 3 Recomp v0.3.9
releases.body:
## Fixed

- **Chapter 1 never loaded after the Prologue.** When you played the Prologue to the end, the game stayed on the
  loading screen forever before Chapter 1, though starting Chapter 1 from chapter select worked. The opening
  film of Chapter 1 never got a decoder. The game's own video decoder, which this runtime used to feed through
  emulated decoder hardware, gave up halfway through its setup once several films had played in one session.
  - Video films are now decoded on the host, the way [Witch-Time](https://github.com/Zexyen/Witch-Time) does it.
    The game's movie player asks for frames, and the host decoder (ffmpeg on Linux, Media Foundation on Windows,
    MediaCodec on Android) supplies them. The game's own hardware decoder path is no longer used for video. Sound is
    unchanged.
  - The game now picks each film's frames and timing itself, so a pre-loaded next film can no longer leak into
    the one that is playing.
  - `NX_MOVIE_DECODER=game` in the config brings back the old decoder path, in case a film misbehaves.

## Verified

- Steam Deck: the Prologue played through by hand into Chapter 1. In a scripted test, Chapter 1's opening film
  played three times in a row in one session (it used to hang on the third), with no missing frames. Film frames
  were also checked against the source: correct picture and colours.
- Windows: builds, unit tests pass.
- Android: built by CI; not yet played on a phone with this change.

## Also

- Steam Deck performance in the README corrected: the Prologue runs at **50–60 fps** (median 60, 90% of the time
  57 or more, over a full playthrough), not about 36.
- Discord Rich Presence is removed (Windows), along with its setting.
- For debugging: the log now names each game phase as it changes, and `NX_PHASE_AT` / `debug_cmd.txt` can send the
  game to a phase (such as the title screen) for repeatable tests.

## Coming from v0.3.8

releases.name: v0.3.8: Android starts with default settings
releases.body:
## Fixed (Android)

- **The game could stop before the title screen with default settings.** The buffer that carries each frame's data
  to the GPU was 64 MB on Android. The title scene sends about 32 MB a frame, so with a few frames in flight the
  buffer filled, and the game stopped with "GPU hang" in `nx.log` (after many "upload buffer full" lines). The default
  is now 256 MB on phones with 8 GB of memory or more, and 128 MB below that.
  - Checked on a Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 phone with default settings: 64 MB failed on every start; 128 and 256 MB hold
    30 fps with no overflow, and the game plays (Prologue fight; the phone-built game reaches the hub).
  - If you had set `NX_UPLOAD_RING_MB` in `config.txt` yourself, nothing changes for you.
  - Install the new APK and tap **SET UP** again so the phone rebuilds the game with the new runtime.

## Also

- README: a new Features section (English, 简体中文, 日本語) listing the settings panel, mods and code patches,
  ultrawide, detail options, high refresh rates, Steam Deck use and updates.
- Realtime cutscenes at 60 fps were measured again with a probe that does not disturb frame pacing, and confirmed:
  every 60 Hz frame is a new step of the game, at the right speed.

Windows and Linux builds are unchanged in behaviour.

releases.name: Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.14
releases.body:
## Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.14: rendimiento recuperado

### Cambios

- **Rendimiento recuperado en procesadores con solo 2 núcleos rápidos** (Helio G85/G88, MT6769 y similares). Desde la versión anterior, todos los hilos del juego se fijaban a los núcleos rápidos. En estos procesadores eso los metía todos en solo 2 núcleos, y el juego iba peor que antes. Ahora solo se fijan cuando hay al menos 4 núcleos rápidos; si no, Android los reparte como antes.
- **Reportes más completos.** Se guardan las tres últimas sesiones del registro del juego, no solo dos: muchos jugadores reabren el juego un par de veces tras un cierre antes de reportar, y la sesión del cierre se perdía. En el resumen del issue, las trazas del cierre van abreviadas para que quepan más líneas del juego.

Dos APK: **arm64** y **armeabi-v7a**. Android 10+, Vulkan 1.1+. Misma firma; se instalan como actualización. Se adjunta `NFSU1-v0.2.14-SHA256SUMS.txt`.

releases.name: Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.13
releases.body:
## Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.13: driver recomendado para tu GPU

### Driver Vulkan recomendado para tu procesador

- **El launcher te dice qué driver usar.** En *Opciones › Driver Vulkan* ahora aparece la GPU de tu teléfono y el driver que le conviene:
  - **Snapdragon (Adreno 6xx/7xx):** Turnip (Mesa), si el driver del sistema va lento o con errores gráficos.
  - **MediaTek, Exynos, Tensor o Unisoc con Mali-G57 o más nueva:** PanVK (Mesa), con la misma condición.
  - **Mali-G52/G72/G76 o más antiguas:** el driver del sistema (PanVK aún es experimental en ellas).
  - **PowerVR (Moto g54, Helio G35/G37…) y Samsung Xclipse:** el driver del sistema. No hay un driver alternativo que funcione en ellas.
- **Aviso si el driver no es para tu GPU.** Si eliges un driver hecho para otra GPU (por ejemplo, Turnip en una Mali o PanVK en una Adreno), el launcher avisa de que el juego probablemente no arrancará.

La app no incluye ningún driver: los importas tú como ZIP (adrenotools) desde el mismo diálogo.

Dos APK: **arm64** y **armeabi-v7a**. Android 10+, Vulkan 1.1+. Misma firma; se instalan como actualización. Se adjunta `NFSU1-v0.2.13-SHA256SUMS.txt`. Incluye todo lo de la v0.2.12.

releases.name: Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.12
releases.body:
## Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.12: volver al juego sin cierres y reportes completos

### Correcciones

- **Cierre al volver al juego.** Si salías a otra app y volvías, el juego podía cerrarse en el primer fotograma. Android libera la ventana del juego al pasar a segundo plano, pero la superficie Vulkan seguía usándola y se destruía después. Ahora la superficie conserva su ventana hasta que se destruye.

### Reportes más útiles

- **El resumen del issue ya trae las líneas del juego.** Antes se tomaban de logcat y, cuando pulsabas *Reportar*, Android ya las había borrado: casi todos los issues llegaban con "últimas líneas del juego" vacío. Ahora salen del registro propio del juego (`game.log`), y logcat solo aporta las líneas del cierre.
- **Lecturas de archivo incompletas en el registro.** Si el juego pide más datos de los que recibe de un archivo, se anota el archivo, la posición y su tamaño. Así podremos ver si un cierre viene de un archivo del juego dañado o incompleto.

### Ajustes para teléfonos con GPU débil

- Con una GPU que no llega a resolución nativa o al 75% (PowerVR de MediaTek como el Moto g54, Mali-G52/G57 de gama baja, Adreno 610/613/619, Unisoc T6xx), el launcher pregunta **una sola vez** al pulsar JUGAR si quieres usar ajustes ligeros. Puedes elegir *Jugar así* y nada cambia.

releases.name: Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.11
releases.body:
## Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.11: mega actualización

Revisamos los reportes y los zip de diagnóstico que nos enviaron. Esta versión trae las mismas mejoras de fondo que Most Wanted y Underground 2.

### Estabilidad

- **Lecturas de archivos completas.** En algunos teléfonos, Android entregaba los archivos del juego a trozos y el juego tomaba un archivo a medias por uno completo, lo que podía cerrar el juego al cargar. Ahora se lee hasta el final.
- **Protección para GPU PowerVR (MediaTek, p. ej. Moto g54 / Dimensity 7020).** El driver Vulkan de MediaTek se caía al crear el primer pipeline gráfico. Ahora, si el driver falla, el port reintenta con configuraciones más simples hasta encontrar una que funcione. *No hemos podido probarlo en un teléfono PowerVR; si tienes uno, cuéntanos cómo va.*

### Audio

- **Menos saturación.** El mezclador ya no corta el sonido en seco cuando se suman muchos sonidos; ahora lo comprime con suavidad.

### Rendimiento

- **Hilos del juego en los núcleos rápidos.** Se fijan a los núcleos grandes y se le indica a Android cuánto dura cada fotograma (ADPF).

### Controles

- **El botón A del mando también hace Enter** mientras conduces.

### Diagnóstico

- **Registro propio del juego.** Se guarda en `files/game.log` (y la sesión anterior en `game-previous.log`). El botón de diagnóstico los añade al zip.

Dos APK: **arm64** y **armeabi-v7a**. Android 10+, Vulkan 1.1+. Misma firma; se instalan como actualización. Se adjunta `NFSU1-v0.2.11-SHA256SUMS.txt`.

Probado en Samsung Galaxy S25 (arm64): menús y carrera a 60 FPS. La versión armeabi-v7a y la protección PowerVR no se han probado en un teléfono.

## Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.14: rendimiento recuperado

### Cambios

- **Rendimiento recuperado en procesadores con solo 2 núcleos rápidos** (Helio G85/G88, MT6769 y similares). Desde la versión anterior, todos los hilos del juego se fijaban a los núcleos rápidos. En el resumen del issue, las trazas del cierre van abreviadas para que quepan más líneas del juego.

## 💙 Thank you!

CosmoU 0.14.0 is full of ideas and bug reports from the CosmoU Discord – most of all from **Eduard** **. Thank you to everyone who tested the betas and wrote down every little thing. This update is yours! 🎉

## ✨ What's new

### 🎮 Switch 2 – a console of its own
- **Switch 2 support** – Settings → Games & Consoles → Add a console → **Switch 2**: choose your games folder and your Switch 2 emulator (**Eden-NX2**, **Eglantine** or one of their forks). Game files (`.xci`, `.nsp`) and dumped games (a folder with `exefs/main` inside) are found, updates and DLC are not counted as games.
- **✨ Its own interface** – with the Switch 2 on screen, CosmoU becomes a Switch 2: dark glass, the chosen game's colours behind everything, its title big above a row of large squares, one frame that glows in blue and red, a dock of round buttons. **Y** opens the **Library** (Recent · Most played · A–Z · Favorites, **/** searches), **+** a full **page for each game**, **Home** (or **Q**) **Quick Settings**. *Dark* and *Light*, soft sounds that play a little scale along the row.

## 💙 Thank you, Eduard!

CosmoU 0.13.3 is built on ideas and bug reports by **Eduard** in the CosmoU Discord – pictures and music per console, your own order, marks, your own consoles, apps in full screen and so much more. Thank you for testing every beta and for every idea. This update is yours! 🎉

## ✨ What's new
### 🎨 One CosmoU, and a Switch that feels like a Switch
- **🎮 The Switch has its own interface** – with the Switch on screen, CosmoU looks and works like a Switch: **Home** with your last played games in one row (A starts the first one right away), round buttons below (All Software, Play Activity, Themes, Controllers, Consoles, System Settings, Power), **All Software** with sorting (**Y**) and search (**/**), a page for each game (**+**), **Quick Settings** on the Home button (or **Q**), *Basic White* and *Basic Black*, its own clicks. No Wii U Home, no Plaza, no buddies there. With a Wii U as well: the circles at the top left (or **L / R**) switch the whole window. Settings → Appearance → Switch → *Its own interface* turns it off.

releases.body:
## 💙 Thank you, Eduard!

Everything in CosmoU 0.13.1 comes from ideas and bug reports by **Eduard** in the CosmoU Discord. Thank you for testing so much and for all the great ideas – this update is yours! 🎉

## ✨ What's new

### 🏝️ Your own picture and music for each console
**Settings → Appearance** has two new rows: **Background picture for …** and **Music for …**.
- Switch to a console (Wii U, Switch, 3DS …), choose any picture and any music file from your computer or phone – done.
- Every console keeps its own: your Zelda picture on the Wii U, something else on the Switch, another one on the 3DS.
- The picture lies behind the glass with a soft veil, so everything stays readable – it looks best with **Liquid Glass**.
- **Remove** brings back the theme's look and music.

### 🎨 Theme files with a picture
A `.cosmoutheme` can now bring a background picture, built on Liquid Glass:
```json
{ "name": "Great Sea", "base": "liquid-glass", "image": "sea.jpg", "music": "song.ogg" }
```
**Share** saves the theme with its picture and music. The guide: [docs/THEMES.md](https://github.com/Eryski/CosmoU/blob/main/docs/THEMES.md).

### ⏭️ Faster pages on the 3DS and Wii home screens

releases.name: CosmoU 0.13.0
releases.body:
## ✨ A calmer, clearer CosmoU

CosmoU 0.13 reworks the whole interface. All the features are still there, just sorted better, so every window and every theme feels like one product: easy to understand on the first start, calm with a big library, readable from the sofa.

## What changed

- **Play is always the strongest button** – in Covers, Grid, the Wii U Look and the game details. Details and the other actions are quieter.
- **Grid** – a calm banner: the cover sharp in front of its own softly blurred colours, instead of a giant pixelated picture.
- **Game details** – a smaller cover, Play first, *Add to favorites* as a quiet toggle, one line instead of four empty statistics before the first play, the tools in one row, save data and updates as simple rows.
- **Settings** – a calmer category bar (only the open category is in colour), a bigger search with its shortcut (Ctrl F / ⌘F).
- **Quick Menu** – your games first, then three clear groups: **Look**, **Sound** and **System**.
- **Theme gallery** – big cards with a preview picture of every theme.
- **Empty screens lead somewhere** – *Clear search*, *Show the library*, or the folder button of the console you're looking at.

releases.name: CapyPS5 v0.0.6
releases.body:
Sixth alpha of the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android, and the first with **PS4 backward compatibility**: PS4 games now run in CapyPS5 the way they do on a real PS5. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**New: PS4 backward compatibility**

A PS5 runs PS4 games on its own hardware. CapyPS5 does the same in software: PS4 games use the same x86-64 JIT, system libraries and Vulkan renderer as PS5 games, and only what the PS4 does differently was added.
- **GPU:** PS4 (GCN gfx7) shaders and registers, PS4 render targets and texture tiling, CMASK and HTile fast clears, cube and volume textures, and the PS4 Gnm driver calls.
- **System:** PS4 executables and the modules games ship, the PS4 memory layout and flexible memory budget, and PS4 save data and trophies.
- PS4 games go in the same game folders as PS5 games (a folder with `eboot.bin` and `sce_sys/param.sfo`) and carry a **PS4** mark in the library.
- This is the first release with it. 2D and Unity games run best; Unreal Engine 4 games start but are slow; many games don't boot yet. Lower the resolution for big games.

**Also new**

releases.name: CapyPS5 v0.0.5
releases.body:
Fifth alpha of the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android. Mali GPUs on their system driver can now run games, and the FPS counter shows how many frames CapyPS5 Framegen adds. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**New**
- **Mali on the system driver:** that driver cannot sample BCn compressed textures, so the GPU used to be rejected. CapyPS5 now decompresses those textures on the GPU when it uploads them (BC1 to BC7, including BC6H HDR textures). GPUs that support BCn keep using it directly.
- **PanVK on Mali:** the GPU is no longer rejected when the driver lacks vertex-stage stores or dual-source blending.
- **Framegen counter:** with CapyPS5 Framegen on, the FPS counter reads *XX FPS - YY FG*: XX are the game's own frames, YY the total including generated ones. The options are now called *Framegen x2*, *x3* and *x4*.
- **HDR10 output:** games that output HDR10 are converted to SDR for the screen.

**Fixed**
- Tessellation: quad domains, fractional-even spacing, counterclockwise output and masked hull control points.

releases.name: CapyPS5 v0.0.4
releases.body:
Fourth alpha of the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android. More than 100 games now run correctly according to testers' reports, and this release adds CapyPS5 Framegen. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**New**
- **CapyPS5 Framegen:** optional frame generation. It draws in-between frames from the motion between two game frames, so a game at 30 FPS is shown at 60. Off by default; turn it on in *Settings → Performance* (1 per frame, or up to 3). Adds one frame of latency and some GPU load; works best from 25 FPS up.
- New performance options in *Settings → Performance*: shadow resolution, early depth testing and a frame rate limit (30 or 20 FPS).
- Physical keyboard input and an on-screen keyboard toggle for text fields, and system dialogs that can now be answered.
- Android 16 and devices with 16 KB memory pages are supported.

**Fixed**
- Unreal Engine 5 games: graphics and async compute hand work back and forth several times per frame, and each hand-off waited up to 100 ms. Menus that ran at 0–2 FPS now move.
- Games whose shadows use depth-compare texture gathers (Castlevania: Belmont's Curse) closed after the menu.

releases.name: CapyPS5 v0.0.3
releases.body:
Third alpha of the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android. Fixes for the logs testers sent on v0.0.2, CPU work for Unreal Engine games, and more from KytyPS5. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**Fixed**
- Games that use fibers (sceFiber) closed the emulator at start on ARM ("Fiber context switching is only implemented on x86_64", Toy Story Retro Roundup). Fibers now switch the game's own registers. First support: please report how fiber games behave.
- Final Fantasy VII Rebirth: sceKernelFtruncate, which it calls when saving, is now available.
- Mewgenics: pthread_setcanceltype is now available.
- The game clock (RDTSC) ran about 23 % faster than the frequency games are told; they now match.
- Very large GPU compute dispatches (over 65535 groups, as in Astro Bot) are split to fit Adreno limits.
- Unity backtraces no longer follow a bogus frame at the start of each guest thread.

**New**
- Unreal Engine games: the TLS and process clock reads they make millions of times a second run inside the game code instead of calling into the emulator.
- Shaders can read the real GPU clock (S_MEMREALTIME) on drivers that offer it.

Second alpha of the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android. Fixes for what testers reported on v0.0.1, a trophy screen, and 60 games on the compatibility list. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**Fixed**
- Virtual controller: several buttons can now be held at once.
- Physical controllers: the left stick no longer presses the d-pad (it moved menus and cursors, as in Mewgenics).
- Adreno 6xx with Turnip (such as Adreno 660) no longer closes at start for lack of 8-bit storage (thanks to deivid22srk).
- Dead Cells has its music, hits and footsteps back: NGS2 voices sent to a rack handle are now heard.
- Games that use user clip planes or uncommon storage texture settings no longer close.

**New**
- Trophies: each game's trophy list, what you have earned, and a card to share your progress.
- A "What's new" card after each update.
- Over 35 improvements from KytyPS5: shaders, tessellation, NGS2 and ATRAC9 audio, flip waits and fewer crashes.

  • High-Performance Native EGL Architecture: Migrated from the legacy v1.1 rendering stack (GLRenderer, DisplayX, VirGL, blit_converter, and Java EffectComposer) to Pipetto-crypto's native C++ EGL renderer at app/src/main/cpp/winlator/renderer/egl.cpp.

  ### New: [NUP](https://github.com/a55uka/nup) Container Format Support

  Added support for the [`.nup` (NX Package)](https://github.com/a55uka/nup) file format — a clean-room container for unencrypted Nintendo Switch and Switch 2
  game dumps.

  **What it does:**
  - Load games directly from `.nup` files — base, updates, and DLC bundled in a single file

  - Zstandard decompression for compressed extents
  - Full integration with the Android game scanner

  **Technical details:**
  - [NUP](https://github.com/a55uka/nup) format v1 spec compliant (magic `NUP\x01`)
  - New `AppLoader_Nup` loader with `DeconstructedRomDirectory` delegation
  - Container validation (superblock, TOC integrity, codec checks)

releases.body:
# XRecomp 0.13.10

<!-- Highlights: what changed, what works, known problems. Written by hand, kept across updates. -->

A crashed game's log can be sent from the device, and Xbox titles run missed code through an interpreter instead of
stopping on it.

- **Share the last game's log** (Settings › Advanced). The in-game « Share log » reads the game's own process, so a
  crash took the log with it. The launcher now writes what the game's last run logged, how its process ended (native
  crash, Java exception, not responding, killed…) and the crash's backtrace into one text file, ready to send. It holds
  no game data.
- **Xbox: an x86 interpreter behind the lifted code** (XBA-303). Code the Prepare missed is interpreted (dispatch
  misses, SEH, save states), and one self-healing round collects every miss.
- **Xbox rendering on GLES**: fixed function on the GPU by default, more texture stage modes, vertex data streamed
  through rings, shader programs compiled off the draw path, with a « Shaders 12/304 » badge while they compile.
- **XMV movies** are read from a disc image in place.

**Known problems**

releases.name: XRecomp v0.13.9
releases.body:
# XRecomp 0.13.9

<!-- Highlights: what changed, what works, known problems. Written by hand, kept across updates. -->

**A retail Xbox 360 game plays on a computer for the first time.** One title, dumped from its owner's disc, now runs from
its logos through its menus into battles (measured up to 1,200 billion guest instructions) with no missing system call,
no draw the renderer refuses, and no guest code left to the interpreter. All of it was measured on Linux. **Nothing was
tried on a handheld yet**: whether it starts, draws, sounds or keeps up on the AYN Thor is unknown.

- **The startup crash is fixed.** `VdInitializeScalerCommandBuffer` wrote its NOPs over the caller's stack, so the game
  returned to address 0 a few frames in.
- **Memory and GPU match the console.** The 4 KB physical view starts one page in, as on the console. The GPU's scratch
  registers reach memory, `WAIT_REG_MEM` suspends an indirect buffer, and the display interrupt reports the vblank.
  Predicated (tiled-rendering) packets run for the selected bin only. Threads keep the affinity they ask for.

releases.body:

<!-- Highlights: what changed, what works, known problems. Written by hand, kept across updates. -->

The Xbox 360 takes a large step towards real games. **No retail game has run on it yet**: everything below is tested on

releases.body:
# XRecomp 0.13.7

<!-- Highlights: what changed, what works, known problems. Written by hand, kept across updates. -->

GameCube games draw correctly on Adreno phones: the picture is complete, steady and fast.

- **Missing surfaces.** GX's cull mode was the wrong way round, which removed the faces a game wanted to keep: floors
  and walls came out black.

  samples through the game's last samplers.

with 2x internal resolution.

**Known problems**

- 4x internal resolution is too heavy for that phone in 3D scenes (about 60 % speed).

## NeoST 0.6.5

Rewind, a cleaner Shifter and DMA sound, smoother audio recovery, and many usability fixes.

Try it in the browser, nothing to install: **[habib256.github.io/neost](https://habib256.github.io/neost/)**.

**What's new**
- **Rewind**: Ctrl+Alt+R steps back in time, floppies included (off by default).

**What's new**
- **Accuracy**: MFP timers start on their own clock edge (Lethal Xcess on STE gets its top border back); MFP, ACIA, SCC and WD1772 closer to their datasheets.
- **Mouse**: drag-and-drop works in games and on the desktop; Chessmaster is now playable.

releases.name: NeoST 0.6.3 — NetUSBee USB and built-in networking
releases.body:
## NeoST 0.6.3 — NetUSBee USB and built-in networking

- **NetUSBee USB devices:** connect a virtual USB keyboard, mouse or disk image
  to either port. Hot-plug devices in Configuration → Network, save them in
  profiles, or use `--usb1` / `--usb2` in the headless runner. USB4TOS drivers
  have been tested with keyboard input, mouse packets and file reads/writes.
  Disk images support read-only mounting. Native ST-side USB drivers are required.
- **Built-in NAT:** IPv4/IPv6 networking without libslirp or GLib, including
  DHCP, DNS, TCP/UDP and explicit port forwarding. STinG/ENEC can load HTTP pages.
- **Hardware accuracy:** further CPU, video, floppy, serial and sound fixes,
  backed by chip documentation and regression benches. Vroom Elite starts on STE.
- **Issue #44:** missing Atari ROMs are reported as skipped Spectrum 512 tests;
  available machines still detect regressions, and partial runs cannot overwrite
  the reference set.

**Save states use format v59. Older states cannot be loaded.** Disk image contents
remain external to save states. USB passthrough and isochronous transfers are not
implemented.

releases.name: NeoST 0.6.2
releases.body:
## NeoST 0.6.2 — closer to the metal

Seven weeks of hardware fidelity work since 0.6.1.

**Deterministic external control.** A `--server` mode, joystick scripts, memory probes
and state exploration: the same script replays the same game down to the cycle. Disks
can be swapped while running and drive B unplugged from the server.

**Serial and keyboard chips rebuilt to match the hardware.** The MFP USART, the Mega STE

## NeoST 0.6.1 — your settings stay put

A patch release. No new features: **23 defects** found and fixed across five rounds of multi-agent bug hunting, plus a hardware-validation pass on the published packages.

### Settings are saved again

On macOS and on every AppImage, NeoST runs from **read-only media**, so it stores its configuration in your user directory — but it never created that directory, and every setting was silently lost when you closed the emulator. **Five of the eight packages were affected.** Machine profile, video, audio and MIDI setup now survive a restart.

### Also fixed

- **The macOS disk image installs by drag and drop.** It shipped with the app alone, no `Applications` shortcut.
- **The web build ships its licences** (GPL-3.0, GPL-2.0, third-party notices), like every other package.
- **A save-state can no longer be reloaded under a different ROM.** The pairing relied on two bytes of TOS version, which five localisations share, so resuming under the wrong ROM froze the CPU without a word. The state format is now **v19**; v18 and older are refused explicitly, with a message that says why.

This release candidate completes support for the cheat instructions implemented by Eden's DMNT engine and improves cheat-file parsing and process targeting.

**This is a pre-release for testing before v0.1.1.** Feedback and reproducible bug reports are welcome. It includes all improvements from rc1 through rc7.

### What's new since rc7

- **Extended cheat instructions:** implemented register comparisons, register save/restore operations and masks, persistent static registers, process pause/resume, and debug logging, with all operand and addressing forms supported by Eden.
- **Cheat execution:** corrected nested if/else handling, loop decoding, arithmetic behavior, and handling of truncated or unknown instructions. Controller input is sampled once per execution so multiple button conditions see the same input state.
- **Cheat files and process targeting:** fixed parsing of names containing Unicode symbols or accents. Memory operations and pause/resume now target the process identified by the cheat metadata, with a cached non-owning process reference.

releases.name: Ruzu v0.1.1-rc7
releases.body:
This release candidate fixes several cheat-engine decoding errors, adds missing process-memory service calls, and addresses an applet command that caused some game to abort.

**This is a pre-release for testing before v0.1.1.** Feedback and reproducible bug reports are welcome. It includes all improvements from rc1 through rc6.

### What's new since rc6

- **Cheat execution:** corrected data widths, register selection, immediate values, and pointer-chain offsets. These errors could prevent loaded cheats from taking effect.
- **Process-memory services:** wired `SetProcessMemoryPermission`, `MapProcessMemory`, and `UnmapProcessMemory` into both ARM64 and ARM32 system-call dispatch. Aligned permission handling and validation order with Eden, with tests for writable aliases, unmapping, and error handling. This addresses missing calls needed by injected cheat modules; end-to-end compatibility with third-party CheatVM modules is not yet verified.
- **Applet compatibility:** added Eden's success response for `ILibraryAppletAccessor` command 90. Also implemented `GetLibraryAppletInfo` to return the child applet's identity and mode.

releases.name: Ruzu v0.1.1-rc6
releases.body:
This release candidate fixes an audio-update parsing error that could cause invalid mixer data and audio glitches.

**This is a pre-release for testing before v0.1.1.** Feedback and reproducible bug reports are welcome. It includes all improvements from rc1 through rc5.

### What’s new since rc5

- **Audio update parsing:** the audio renderer now respects the splitter block size declared in the update header. Previously, it could read the following mixer block at the wrong offset, resulting in invalid mix counts or rejected audio updates.
- **Input validation:** added bounds checks for declared splitter blocks.
- **Regression coverage:** added synthetic tests covering splitter block boundaries, subsequent mixer updates, and header layout.

This correction addresses a likely cause of the audio errors reported in [issue #21](https://github.com/vricosti/ruzu-emu/issues/21). Confirmation through extended gameplay is still needed.

### Known limitations

Unsupported shader instructions may still cause missing graphics or prevent a scene from rendering. This release does not resolve every freeze, black-screen issue, or audio glitch.

releases.body:
**This release candidate improves shader error handling, Windows build support, and diagnostics for freezes and black screens.

**This is a pre-release for testing before v0.1.1.** Feedback and reproducible bug reports are welcome. It includes the improvements from rc1 through rc4.

### What’s new since rc4

- **Shader stability:** unsupported shader instructions now produce an error that the Vulkan pipeline compiler can handle, rather than terminating the GPU worker. This improves error recovery but does not add support for those instructions.
- **Graphics compatibility:** aligned constant-buffer and texture validation with Eden and corrected how constant-buffer values are recorded for shader caching.
- **Windows memory handling:** aligned unsupported memory-protection handling with Eden, avoiding an unconditional panic.

## NHL Legacy 2027 — 1.0.3

Выбранный в лаунчере язык RU/EN теперь используется на экране подготовки графики и в Android-настройках во время игры: меню Select, настройках кнопок, окне назначения и режиме перемещения кнопок. Лаунчер переключается сразу, внутриигровые экраны — при следующем запуске игры. Язык оригинального игрового интерфейса выбирается отдельно.

The launcher’s RU/EN choice now carries into graphics preparation and in-game Android controls: the Select menu, game settings, button mapping, and button-layout editor. The launcher updates immediately; in-game Android screens use the choice on the next game launch. The original game language remains separate.

Signed Android ARM64 APK, `versionCode 14`, same package and signing certificate as 1.0.2. Native libraries, game assets, and the ISO importer are unchanged byte for byte. The Y700 installed this version over 1.0.2 without deleting imported game files. Device checks confirmed the graphics-preparation screen and game settings in both EN and RU, the English button-mapping and layout screens, and both Select-menu languages. A match was not replayed for this text-only update.

## NHL Legacy 2027 — 1.0.1

### Русский

- Первый публичный APK для Android ARM64 с лаунчером NHL Legacy 2027.
- Игровые файлы импортируются **только из ISO**. Проверяются 20 файлов по размеру и SHA-256; ZIP игровых данных больше не поддерживается. ZIP составов и драйверов остаются отдельными функциями.
- Два режима матча: 960 × 540 и 1280 × 720, интерфейс 1280 × 720. Доступны настройки полной арены, управления, системного или пользовательского Vulkan-драйвера и очистка графического кеша.
- При ошибке либо отмене импорта прежняя установка сохраняется. Успешное обновление сохраняет кеши и пользовательские данные.

Полный импорт ISO подтверждён пользователем на Lenovo Y700 (`TB321FU`, Android 15); все 20 файлов дополнительно проверены независимым чтением. Полное прохождение и совместимость со всеми GPU не подтверждены. Возможны просадки FPS и неверная поза вратаря в отдельных повторах.

Для игры требуется собственный оригинальный ISO NHL Legacy Edition. Образ и игровые данные здесь не распространяются. После импорта ISO может быть удалён с устройства, поскольку нужные файлы установлены в хранилище приложения.

## Xenra 0.5.0

### A new platform: iOS

Xenra ships on iPad and iPhone for the first time, as one app with both
consoles:

- Xbox 360 and original Xbox cores, the Metal renderer, JIT through StikDebug,
  and the floating pad with physical controller support.
- Dashboard, game library with box art and covers, setup wizard, per-game
  settings, sharing logs, crash and thermal reports.
- Xbox 360 System Link netplay over the local network, with a signed-in profile.
- Original Xbox Live through Insignia: console DNS, setup assistant and the
  retail dashboard, all from the app.

The iOS and Android screens share their wording and layout, so a guide written
for one applies to the other.

### Original Xbox: the Performance core

The Performance core is the default original Xbox core on Android, chosen per
game at launch. xemu remains for the dashboard, the Insignia setup assistant and
the games the performance core cannot run, exactly the split the game menu
already understands. The core names in the library and per-game settings are now
Performance and Compatibility, matching the 360 side.

### Mali GPUs and compatibility rendering

releases.body:
## Xenra 0.4.5 (pre-release)

The biggest performance update yet, on both consoles.

### Performance and Compatibility cores
Every game, Original Xbox and Xbox 360, now has two cores. Performance is the default; switch any game from its menu in the library.

### Original Xbox
- New Performance core, integrated with Xenra's controls, display options and in-game menu. Most games run at full speed; Forza Motorsport 12 -> 30 fps.
- Compatibility core updated to the latest xemu, with the upstream graphics accuracy fixes (lighting, vertex shaders, textures, surfaces, timers).
- Crash and stability fixes across the renderer, audio and save states.

### Xbox 360
- Major GPU overhaul: Forza Horizon 2 10 -> 30 fps, Halo 3 up to 2x faster.
- Game fixes including Forza Motorsport 4, Need for Speed: Most Wanted, Gears of War 3, Rise of the Tomb Raider and Crysis 3.
- Synced with the latest Xenia Edge.
- Fixed textures and objects disappearing for a frame.
- GTA V boots again with its title update installed.
- Custom GPU drivers can run the GPU at full clocks.

### App

* New features for mod developers:
  * Added optional dependency functionality, which allows mods to run different code based on the presence of another mod. See [this section of the template mod toml](https://github.com/Zelda64Recomp/MMRecompModTemplate/blob/68d8978d3b4aa44df0e7e77ce427e3ef5abde004/mod.toml#L42) and [this header](https://github.com/Zelda64Recomp/MMRecompModTemplate/blob/68d8978d3b4aa44df0e7e77ce427e3ef5abde004/include/recomputils.h#L37) for more details.
  * Added exports to get the return value of a function from within a return hook. See [this header](https://github.com/Zelda64Recomp/MMRecompModTemplate/blob/68d8978d3b4aa44df0e7e77ce427e3ef5abde004/include/recomputils.h#L11) for more details.
  * Hooks and callbacks are now run in an order determined by the order of mods in the mod menu. Regular hooks and callbacks are run from top to bottom, while return hooks are run in the reverse of that order. Reordering mods after starting the game does not affect this ordering.
